description: Reserve rows for the fixed-height Keybar so it is never the element clipped by the CAM-345 height={rows} bound; shrink StoriesSection's window instead.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Box `height` sets the element height in lines and `flexShrink` is the standard Yoga flexbox shrink factor; the docs do not spell out overflow-clipping, so the CAM-345 empirical behavior (a fixed height={rows} clips overflowing children, and flexShrink=0 children do not shrink to reclaim space) governs the fix. No breaking change or deprecation affecting Box layout props.

userStories.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding
userStories.notes: CRITICAL [src/ui/Dashboard.tsx:636]: Off-by-one at the STORIES_COMPACT_THRESHOLD boundary reintroduces the CAM-345 keybar-clip the story fixes. computeStoriesLayout admits the chrome path at budget>=4 and sets windowSize=Math.max(1, budget - SECTION_CHROME_HEIGHT - 1); at budget==4 the Math.max clamps 0 back up to 1, reclaiming the line the documented '-1 overflow-hint reservation' was meant to hold. With a truncated story list, chrome(3)+row(1)+overflowHint(1)=5 > budget(4), so the composed frame is rows+1 lines and Ink's <Box height={rows}> hard-clips the Keybar's final 'q  close pane' row below the fold. Verified by independent render: recent=[] + 8 stories at rows=26 drops 'close pane' (rows 25/27/28 render it). Violates AC #2 ('the Keybar q close pane hint row renders and is not clipped'). Fix: raise STORIES_COMPACT_THRESHOLD to reserve the overflow-hint line (e.g. SECTION_CHROME_HEIGHT + 2) or fall back to the compact/chromeless path whenever the honored window would truncate the list; add a regression test at the budget==4 boundary.

userStories.title: Reserve keybar rows; derive StoriesSection window from pane height
userStories.description: As a dashboard user in a short tmux pane, I need the Keybar's 'd  focus orchestrator' / 'q  close pane' hint rows to stay visible so that keybinding discoverability is preserved, instead of the keybar being the element clipped below the CAM-345 height={rows} fold.
acceptanceCriteria: The StoriesSection visible window size is derived from `rows` (useWindowSize, Dashboard.tsx:183) minus the reserved fixed-section heights (SummaryPanel/Loop at its maximum height including optional tokens/cost rows, RecentSection, Keybar, and inter-section gaps), threaded into computeWindow's size argument (Dashboard.tsx:601) instead of the hardcoded STORIES_WINDOW=8. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

In a pane shorter than the natural composed content, the Keybar's 'd  focus orchestrator' and 'q  close pane' hint rows render and are not clipped: a rendered frame under a small `rows` positively contains both hint rows. [oracle: named-command bun test]

The composed frame line count never exceeds `rows` in list mode or detail mode (the CAM-345 bound is preserved); the surviving <=rows line-bound assertions in test/dashboard.test.ts still pass. [oracle: named-command bun test]
StoriesSection's existing '…N more' overflow hint reflects the reduced window size when the window shrinks to fit the remaining rows. [oracle: named-command bun test]

The two now-obsolete negative assertions in test/dashboard.test.ts (~:1163 asserting the frame does NOT match /focus orchestrator/, ~:1947 asserting not toContain('close pane')) are inverted to positively assert the keybar hint rows are present. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -nE "not\.(toMatch|toContain).*(focus orchestrator|close pane)" test/dashboard.test.ts]
Detail mode (StoryDetailView + DetailKeybar) keeps its fixed keybar visible under the same rows bound. [oracle: named-command bun test]

The Keybar's own content is NOT windowed and sections are NOT reordered (footer stays bottom-most): STORIES_WINDOW is no longer the sole window source but the Keybar still renders all KEYBAR_COMMANDS rows plus both hint rows. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Verify the screen renders correctly (via ink-testing-library) in both a short pane and a tall pane. [oracle: named-command bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file core fix: src/ui/Dashboard.tsx plus its test test/dashboard.test.ts. Thread `rows` (Dashboard.tsx:183 useWindowSize) into the list-mode composition and into StoriesSection so computeWindow (Dashboard.tsx:699-708) receives a rows-derived size instead of STORIES_WINDOW=8 (Dashboard.tsx:43). GOTCHAS (from issue spec): (1) all list-mode children are flexShrink={0} (Dashboard.tsx:277/:279/:291) so the outer height={rows} alone will NOT reclaim space via flexbox shrink; the fix MUST reduce Stories' content (window row count), not rely on shrink. (2) SummaryPanel/Loop has optional tokens/cost rows so reserve conservatively using its MAXIMUM height so the keybar is never clipped when those rows are present. (3) RecentSection is already capped to RECENT_ENTRIES_COUNT=5 upstream (src/commands/dashboard.ts:700); do NOT re-window it. (4) Do NOT window the Keybar itself (Dashboard.tsx:307-331) and do NOT reorder sections. (5) Do NOT re-introduce the CAM-345 'Loop' header ghost: frame must stay bounded to rows (provenance CAM-306/CAM-321 width-gate, CAM-345 height-bound). Ink invariant: success/failure via glyph, never divider color. Ink test gotchas grep-verified in scripts/cam/patterns.md: ink-testing-library's fake Stdout has NO `rows` getter (only columns=100) so `stdout.rows` is falsy and Ink falls through to `terminal-size`/tput — use test/helpers/mock-terminal-size.ts installTerminalSizeMock() (CAM-201) and drive height via the render seam, and prefer waitForFrame content-polling over fixed ticks (test/helpers/flush-ink.ts). See patterns.md CAM-201/CAM-306/CAM-66 bullets for the Dashboard-render test technique.
